race.comment: ROCK ABOUT (3) has the right profile after placings at both runs this campaign, with the Seymour third carrying extra merit because he was wide without cover and still finished 1.5L of the winner. The rise to 1400m suits, though he is likely to drift back from the draw and be charging late. SEINFELD (5) resumes for the Douglas camp and strips fitter for two Mornington jump-outs. Made showed positive signs in his debut prep, so if he's made natural progression, he's sure to be competitive. SILVER SNOW (6) is a seasoned maiden, yet his Yarra Valley second was sound and warrants safe keeping for exotic players. LA VELOCITA (10) has been hard to fault for consistency, with repeated placings, solid track form and a checked run last start, although 1400m is new territory for her.
